//: Copy to config.json (keep it out of git) and edit. Every coin amount is a decimal STRING in that coin's units. Keys starting with // are comments. README.md explains every field.
// acknowledgeRealFunds: live mode refuses to start unless this is true AND --confirm names the wallet address
// maxSpendUsd: the most this wallet may LOSE in the run: fees, gas, activation, trading costs, and anything sent to an address other than the wallet itself. Checked before every step.
// allowExistingAccount: a brand-new wallet is the expected start; set true to resume with --only on a wallet the runner already funded
// deposit: USDC sent from this chain to the wallet's own SoDEX deposit address. A new account keeps 1 USDC as its activation fee.
// withdrawValuechainOther: skipped unless receivers.valuechain is set to ANOTHER address you control
// extraDeposits: more USDC deposits from other EVM chains the wallet is funded on, e.g. { "chain": "BASE_ETH", "amount": "5" }
// extraWithdrawals: per chain: the token AND the native coin where both are offered. buyIfMissing market-buys the missing amount on Spot first (fee + spread; the rest stays in Spot).
// receivers: the ONLY addresses other than the wallet itself that anything may be sent to. XRP/XLM: { "address": "r...", "memo": "123" } or { "address": "r...", "noMemo": true }
// builder: OFF (null) by default. To test the Valuescan builder fee (docs/BUILDER-CODES.md) set e.g. { "id": 12345, "feePerps": 50, "feeSpot": 50, "maxFee": 50, "required": false, "revokeAtEnd": true } - fees in tenths of a basis point (perps 0..200, spot 0..2000). enable-trading then approves the fee when SoDEX does not list it yet (ONE more wallet signature), every order of the run must carry the builder, and revoke-builder clears the approval at the end. Find the id with: node tools/check-builder.mjs <builder wallet>
